svg.aria-label: Native recursion keeps one call frame per level of the input, so a 100,000-level tree overflows a 512 KiB stack. quire-walk keeps one typed frame per level on a heap stack and runs enter and exit callbacks from a loop, so native stack use stays constant.
svg.title: Native recursion keeps one call frame per level of the input, so a 100,000-level tree overflows a 512 KiB stack. quire-walk keeps one typed frame per level on a heap stack and runs enter and exit callbacks from a loop, so native stack use stays constant.
